record.question: Who has been honoured with 54th Jnanpith Award?
record.explanation: Answer C: Amitav Ghosh. Amitav Ghosh received the 54th Jnanpith Award; the Jnanpith announcement identifies him as the laureate. Reference: https://www.jnanpith.net/media_image/announcement/54th%20Jnanpith%20Award%20goes%20to%20Amitav%20Ghosh.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: February 2019 (cover page; no day given). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
